In all honestly, after giving this game a fair shot with 16 hours completely solo and getting to late game content, I can say that this game is not good.

While the characters are slightly fun, it is honestly the same boring thing every single run. (Choose which set of perks you want to start off with, brainlessly kill enemies, complete the run, use the over-crowded menu to claim your 7 different in-game currencies that you're not told what to do with, repeat.)

There's only a handful of extremely easy bosses that are boring in concept and boring/tedious to fight. With the exception of one of the final bosses from Ringed City.

The only real challenge in the game is in your first few runs, where you don't have any of the post-game upgrades. Once you have a character that has a proficiency level of 5 or more (or in other words, a main), the game becomes braindead.

A few other minor issues:
• The start-up screen is extremely laggy and sensitive to inputs that could lead to a crash during start-up. (For reference, I am running this game on an RTX 4060)

• The menus are extremely confusing, and borderline disorganised.

• When clicking anything to do with rewards, it is extremely laggy and feels terrible to use. Worse than a Roblox game that's been developed by 1 man. (Believe me, there's an absurd amount of "rewards" that you need to go into a menu to claim after every run)

• More-so a nitpick, but I find that most playable characters and just overall themes of bosses/locations are over-inspired - to the point where I feel like I'm just playing a plagiarised game that rips off Borderlands and Overwatch.

Again, I find this game to be horrible and I would honestly say I regret the time that I've spent on it. Please spare yourself.

The game itself is fun and engaging, can be a little bullet spongy at times, but that can be counteracted with a good build. Only issue I have with it is that it is purely online. (even if you are playing solo) So you still run into server lag, lag in general and getting disconnected and losing all your progress for that run. Literally make this game offline compatible and it would be so much better. Progression is fun and also engaging, if you like crunching numbers. Always a sense of dopamine when you get the next perk. But just like not being able to dodge a devastating attack because of lag even though I would rather play the game solo is a major heartbreak.


Please just make the game compatible with solo play, unless you want the online portion and que up for that stuff.

The [i]idea[/i] of the game is interesting, and the visuals aren't bad, but it mostly fails to deliver. It says it's a roguelite, but it feels like they're focusing more on the gacha side of things, and all the different menus are annoying.

For a free game though, it's worth at least trying, if you think it might be your thing.

Gachashit and poorly optimized, but sorta scratches that Warframe Brain itch. Recommend playing solo, even when it tells you stuff will be "dangerous." Nothing is really dangerous here if you know what you're doing. Players are overtuned relative to the grunts, but the bosses are fkn bullet sponges, Only reason to play MP is if you have friends or want a free pass/faster run.
Voice acting is quite bad and Several of the thumbnails for skins and such look like AI Generated slop.
The tutorial is worse than Warframe's was at launch, since you can't even ask questions in chat until account level 8. It explains literally nothing, at this point I still haven't figured out if there is anything extra to the active reload other than being faster.
Character design is bland at best and wankbait at worst. 
Every time I load up the game I find myself bombarded by information, misleading multilayered similar looking currencies, passes, micro-transactions, and Gacha pulls for skins. None of which is how to actually play the gameplay.
/S Gotta say though, I love that one of the two times I played with others, I literally couldn't load in fast enough to contribute to the trash packs between the bosses 90% of the time, I really felt like I was contributing to the success of the run.

TL/DR, Core gameplay is wildly unbalanced, but fun, Just stick to singleplayer and ignore the microtransactions.

This game has potential for a rogue-like game but man is the optimization awful. There's constant stuttering no matter what I had the graphics settings on. I have a feeling it has more or so to do with the game server side, than my actual computer. I can play majority of my games on Ultra (or very high, if Ultra isn't an option) without a hitch. So it's quite odd that this game causes issues, graphically, which leads me to believe it's more of a server/connection issue.

The game was fun, matchmaking doesn't seem to work though. I sat for a couple of minutes (at least 3-4) without being able to match with anyone else. Would probably be more fun with friends than randoms anyway.

I also hate the hand holding that the tutorial puts you through (one of the reasons why I don't play mobile games). Everything is locked and you can't do anything until you play through the tutorial and then a full play-through of the first level. I get tired of games doing this. Is this a mobile game? Seems like it is.

I loved this game, what I did not love was the intensely evident monetization and p2w mechanics. The bonuses for paying giving you better runs on a leader board, the skin that gives you a bonus for playing it. Simply put too many things that made it a huge issue for me, I did try to defend the game but enough was enough. To the point that I actually uninstalled it and left their discord. 

SO I will keep the rating simple for a 5 point score. 

Builds: 1  out of 2 points
Some characters are completely nerfed by boss mechanics and positions. Meaning their skills can't directly affect certain bosses. Further, the build diversity is minimal, it is fun but to succeed you have few options as certain setups are constantly more effective than others. 

Gameplay: 1 out of 2 points
The game has huge stuttering issues, yes this is game play but it was to the point that some shots and attacks would not register. So while it is fun to play, runs could be broken or made by whether or not you could actually do damage and if it was registering. 

Now you did have mods you could add to your characters, but the reliability of getting a good mod was super rng and if you don't pray you don't play kind of mentality. 

Graphics: .5 out of 1 points
The skins were nice but too expensive for what they were asking for. Further the environments were way too repetitive. By the time you have played each map 10 times you knew exactly what it was. 

Overall it was a 2.5 out of 5. I liked it because it scratched an itch that I had at the time, but as I put more and more hours into it, it was clear it was not where it needed to be. That I only played it because as I said I didn't have anything else I wanted to play more and I had no money to do so.

Let's describe this game the best way possible. 
A friend and I installed the game a few days ago, we went to play and were having a good time initially. 
A roguelike shooter with great visuals, a strong gameplay loop and overall easy to learn before having a blast! What could go wrong?? And that's when it went wrong.. 

This game is mishandled by the developers and has a huge "Performance Problem" it isn't hardware related and is impacting the entire community and the developers haven't released any information on coming to terms with fixing this issue so it's essentially dead-weight until then. 

According to information from the community they have your FPS & Ping linked so if one spikes the other is impacted which creates huge performance issues and this annoying stutter effect.

This game has so much potential, but at best, the devs were told by the publisher to polish what they had and ship it.

The game can be fun, but it can't handle that much math. You'll end up stuttering with servers struggling to figure out how much damage was done and if the enemy should be dead. A lot of the time you'll see bosses go from dozens of health bars to dead with no logical explanation even when playing solo.

The characters are blatant ripoffs of other heroes from hero shooter games (i.e. OW, Apex).

The gun play isn't terrible, but it's basically pointless since the game heavily favors abilities. Hell, there's even a build that will prioritize reloading over shooting. 

The bosses are horribly balanced. There's one boss, Jory, who players have been begging to be fixed due to either attacks being way too powerful or the damage is being calculated multiple times for a single hit leading to runs ending because of either server lag or stutter.

Oh, right, the servers. They have multiple servers around the world. The server you pick to play on doesn't matter since you play on whatever server the party leader is on. I ended up on an Asian server yesterday, and with my ping over 300, most of my hits didn't land, but the enemies and boss's hits landed a fair amount. I was shooting through an enemy and hitting one behind it. 

But hey, you have to play on servers across the world because the game is super dead. As of typing this, the current player count is 466 with a 24 hour peak of 657. The highest the game hit when it started was just under 6k. I know games are supposed to have a drop in players, but not one that big and not in less than a month from release.

Those massive problems aside, the devs either don't know what to do with in game currency, or they weren't allowed to finish making the game. There are several currencies that do nothing after a certain point. There's a "talent/skill" tree that you finish pretty early on, and after you keep getting currency for that. It's obvious there's supposed to be more to it based on wording in the game, but no one knows anything about it. 

There are multiple "rogueteers" you can play, but the game punishes you for not picking one and sticking with it. They have proficiency levels which unlock things from new weapons, passives, skill enhancements, etc. It takes longer to get a character to level 10 than it does to get the skill tree done. 

i'd love to recommend this game, I really would, but holy hell does it suck to play in its current state.
